title: Stochastic Gradient Descent: A Nonlinear Time Series Perspective
abstract: arXiv:2610.20894v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper investigates the statistical behavior of Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) with constant step size under the framework of iterated random functions. Compared to previous studies establishing the convergence of SGD in probability measure, e.g., Wasserstein distance, our approach directly provides the convergence in Euclidean distance by showing the Geometric Moment Contraction (GMC) of SGD. This new convergence can address the non-stationarity of SGD due to fixed initial points and can provide a more refined asymptotic analysis of SGD. Specifically, we prove quenched central limit theorem, invariance principle and $\alpha$-stable convergence for averaged SGD (ASGD) regardless of initialization. Furthermore, we provide a novel perspective to understand the impact of step sizes in SGD by studying its derivative with respect to the step size. translated_title: 随机梯度下降：非线性时间序列的视角
translated_abstract: 本文在迭代随机函数的框架下研究了具有恒定步长的随机梯度下降（SGD）的统计行为。与以往建立SGD在概率测度（例如Wasserstein距离）意义下收敛性的研究相比，我们的方法通过证明SGD的几何矩收缩（GMC）性质，直接给出了欧氏距离下的收敛性。这种新的收敛性能够解决由固定初始点导致的SGD非平稳性问题，并能对SGD进行更精细的渐近分析。具体而言，我们证明了平均SGD（ASGD）在任意初始化条件下的淬火中心极限定理、不变原理以及α-稳定收敛性。此外，我们通过研究SGD关于步长的导数，为理解步长对SGD的影响提供了一个新颖的视角。我们证明了导数过程平稳解的存在性，这使得……
tldr: 本文在迭代随机函数框架下，通过几何矩收缩（GMC）证明了恒定步长SGD在欧氏距离下的收敛性，克服了固定初始化带来的非平稳性问题，证明了平均SGD的淬火中心极限定理、不变原理和α-稳定收敛，并通过研究关于步长的导数为理解步长的影响提供了新视角。
en_tdlr: This paper proves Euclidean-distance convergence of constant-step-size SGD via Geometric Moment Contraction (GMC) under the iterated random functions framework, overcoming non-stationarity from fixed initialization, establishing the quenched CLT, invariance principle, and α-stable convergence for averaged SGD, and offering a novel perspective on step size impact through derivative analysis.
